build_hpu_net: build a HierarchicalProbUNet model with default latent dimensions and channel configuration for medical image segmentation
sample_segmentation: sample a segmentation from the prior given an input image tensor using the HPUNet sample method
reconstruct_segmentation: reconstruct a segmentation using the posterior by passing segmentation and image tensors to the reconstruct method
compute_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between posterior and prior distributions at each hierarchical level using the kl method
compute_training_loss: compute the full ELBO or GECO training loss by passing segmentation, image, and mask tensors to the loss method
